verses.1: It will not be a wise call; it will not give any guidance or direction.
verses.2: At the beginning of the roads, there stands the house of guidance.
verses.3: At the doors, according to the manner in which they are opened, there are new openings.
verses.4: I call to you, men, and my voice reaches to the children of Adam.
verses.5: Suddenly, they understood wisdom; while the foolish ones did not understand.
verses.6: Hear, for I will speak; and from the opening of my lips, words will come forth.
verses.7: For truly, I will wait patiently, and my words will be righteous.
verses.8: In righteousness, all the words of my mouth are without any flaw or corruption.
verses.9: They are all present to understand, and they are capable of discovering wisdom.
verses.10: Take away wealth, and also knowledge from the world. Choose wisely.
verses.11: For wisdom is better than all kinds of riches and all desires.
verses.12: I am wise; I have found wisdom and knowledge that can be utilized.
verses.13: The sight of Jehovah’s punishment is terrifying and disgusting. It’s a path of evil, and it’s something that should be avoided at all costs.
verses.14: Without advice or guidance, I am alone and helpless.
verses.15: May kings reign, and those who rule may establish justice.
verses.16: May those who are kind and generous be honored; may all those who judge fairly be praised.
verses.17: I love love, and my lover will find me.
verses.18: May great honor and glory be upon me now, in this time of great justice.
verses.19: Good fruits come from the fields and from various places; my arrival is from a chosen place.
verses.20: In the house of righteousness, I will walk along the paths of judgment.
verses.21: To give my love to them and their children.
verses.22: YHVH, I have been guided by Your ways from the beginning, before all Your works.
verses.23: From eternity I was created from the beginning of the world.
verses.24: In places without mountains, my enemies will not be able to harm me; in places without seas, my defenders will be safe.
verses.25: Before the mountains were formed, I existed before their creation.
verses.26: Until he created the earth and its mountains and hills.
verses.27: In that preparation of the heavens, there I am, in a state of preparation for the coming day.
verses.28: In the midst of their games, they play above the heights of the mountains.
verses.29: In his midst, the sea will not pass through it; neither will waters flow into it. The foundations of the earth will remain stable.
verses.30: And I will be with him always; and there will be days when he is happy, days that are filled with joy before him, at all times.
verses.31: She destroys the land of Egypt, and she causes sorrow to all people.
verses.32: And now, my children, listen to me. Let them follow my ways.
verses.33: Hear the messages and wisdom from them; do not ignore them.
verses.34: Those people who listen to me and cry at my doors, day after day, must also keep the doors of my house closed.
verses.35: For whoever finds life, he will fulfill Jehovah’s desires.
verses.36: And my sins have weighed down my soul; all those who despise me love death.
